site.name: Mona Hukuk
site.tagline: Legal counsel for international clients in Turkey
site.description: Antalya-based law firm representing foreign individuals and companies in immigration, real estate, family, criminal, labor, commercial and IT/AI law matters.

hero.title: Trusted legal counsel for foreign nationals and international business in Turkey.
hero.lead: Mona Hukuk represents expats, investors, and global companies before Turkish courts and authorities — with discretion, fluency in English, and decades of combined experience.

international.title: Built for international clients
international.body: We work in English and understand the procedural reality foreign clients face in Turkey — from the first consultation through enforcement.

fullService.title: Full-service practice
fullService.body: From a residence permit appeal to a commercial dispute, our practice areas cover the everyday and complex needs of foreign clients.

discretion.title: Confidentiality first
discretion.body: Every engagement is handled with the level of discretion expected by private clients, executives, and investors.

ctaBanner.title: Need legal advice in Turkey?
ctaBanner.body: Tell us briefly what you are dealing with and we will respond — usually within one business day.

about.title: About Mona Hukuk
about.lead: An independent Antalya-based law firm focused on the legal needs of foreign individuals and international businesses operating in Turkey.
about.body: Mona Hukuk advises expats, foreign investors, and cross-border companies on the full spectrum of Turkish law that affects their lives and operations in Turkey. Our practice combines local procedural expertise with international working culture: clear English communication, transparent fee structures, and case management that respects clients' time zones.

practiceAreas.title: Practice Areas
practiceAreas.lead: We focus on the matters that most often bring foreign individuals and businesses into contact with the Turkish legal system.
practiceAreas.comingSoon: Detailed practice area pages will be published soon.

team.title: Our Team
team.lead: A small, senior team of attorneys committed to international clients.

members.name: Av. Mustafa AKÇAKUŞ
members.bio: Founding partner of Mona Hukuk, Mustafa specialises in advising technology companies and international clients on IT law, artificial intelligence regulation, and data protection compliance in Turkey.

members.name: Av. Aykut ACAR
members.bio: Founding partner with over a decade of practice, Aykut advises foreign investors and individuals on real estate transactions, corporate matters, family disputes, and enforcement proceedings.

members.name: Av. Murat BOSTAN
members.bio: Murat began his career at the Istanbul Bar Association and has been representing clients before Antalya courts since 2023, focusing on criminal defence, labour disputes, and property matters.

members.name: Av. Mehmet SİMAV
members.bio: Mehmet brings a rigorous, client-focused approach to litigation and dispute resolution, representing individuals and businesses in criminal proceedings, commercial disputes, and family matters.

members.name: Stj. Av. Tuğba Yazar
members.education: Süleyman Demirel University Faculty of Law, 2023
members.bio: Tuğba is actively developing her expertise across health law, immigration, family law, and criminal liability matters, providing support to foreign clients navigating Turkish legal processes.
